_about: A ride through the frustration model for live-set.mjs plugin: four sections from the field guide (Harmonicity and Inharmonicity/proofs/2026-10-17-frustration-sweeps/field-guide.md). Values are in the plugin's own units; the writer normalises them. The device is off when the Set opens and the first beat of play turns it on.

sections.name: Under the edge: B just below, K at 6
Ride coupling: B just past the edge, K 2 to 18 and back
Breathe across the edge (log), two breaths
Strike: thrown past the edge, falling back in a quarter second
